errors.text_span: 包括High、Second H、Mono/lingual-Ch、Half L、Middle、Half L、Second L、Low、Front 2、Front 1、Front F、Half F、Central、Central B、Half B、Back、Rounded、Unrounded、Aspirated、Unaspirated 共19个类别。
errors.evidence: The list of x-axis categories is incorrect. It includes a legend label ("Mono/lingual-Ch"), misses a category ("Half H"), duplicates a category ("Half L"), misnames categories ("Front F" for "Front", "Central B" for "Half B", "Rounded" for "rounded"), and incorrectly states there are 19 categories when there are 18.
The y-axis range shown on the chart is from 0.2 to 1.0, not 0.9.

This description is used for the Monolingual-Ch, Bilingual-Ch, and Bilingual-En lines, but none of them show a consistent downward trend. They are all relatively flat with minor fluctuations, staying in the upper range of the y-axis.
The green Monolingual-Ch line is at approximately 0.9 at "Half L", not 0.77.
The green Monolingual-Ch line is at approximately 0.92 at "Central", not 0.73.
The green Monolingual-Ch line is at approximately 0.92 at "Unaspirated", not 0.75.
The blue Monolingual-En line has circle markers and a solid line, not triangle markers and a dashed line.
The blue Monolingual-En line does not simply go downward. It fluctuates significantly, with multiple sharp increases and decreases.
The blue Monolingual-En line is at approximately 0.44 at "High", not 0.29.

errors.text_span: 随后逐渐上升，在 “Second L” 时达到 0.33
errors.evidence: The blue Monolingual-En line actually decreases from "High" to "Half L" and is at its lowest point in this segment around "Second L" (approx. 0.22), it does not gradually rise to 0.33.

errors.text_span: 其后持续下降到"Front 2" 的 0.33
errors.evidence: The Monolingual-En line has a data gap at "Front 2"; there is no data point there.
The x-axis does not contain a category named "Central B". The relevant categories are "Central" and "Half B".

errors.text_span: 随后逐渐上升至"Unaspirated" 的 0.53
errors.evidence: The blue Monolingual-En line shows a steep upward trend towards the end of the axis, with the value at "unrounded" already being ~0.75. A final value of 0.53 is inconsistent with this trend and far too low.
The Bilingual-Ch line is yellow, has circle markers, and a solid line, not orange with square markers.
The yellow Bilingual-Ch line is at approximately 0.9 at "Back", not 0.8.
The Bilingual-En line is orange, has circle markers, and a solid line, not red with diamond markers and a dashed line.
The orange Bilingual-En line is at approximately 0.81 at "High", not 0.76.
The orange Bilingual-En line is at approximately 0.82 at "Middle", not 0.75.

errors.text_span: 之后略微下降至 "Unaspirated" 的 0.73
errors.evidence: The orange Bilingual-En line ends at approximately 0.8 at "Unaspirated", not 0.73.
